title: Ironhollow Rising Revisited
author: S. M. Marchetti
blurb: August Zhou, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
